title: Plan AC: Brand Vlog & IP Persona
summary: Persona → content pillars → presenter / avatar → serialization → operations
scenario: For companies or creators building a consistent persona through a vlog series, turning output into content assets and follower trust.

steps.title: Persona
steps.detail: Define the IP's core persona — identity tags, speaking style, point of view and visual look — plus a one-line description and three rules you will never break. Every piece of content follows this.
steps.tips: Give the persona a contrasting hook, like 'a deadpan engineer telling deadpan jokes', so people remember it.

steps.title: Content pillars
steps.detail: Turn the persona into 3-4 fixed pillars (behind the scenes, Q&A, failure moments, etc.), each with a set format, length and posting rhythm.
steps.tips: Name pillars with a 'series feel' so viewers anticipate the next episode.

steps.title: Presenter / avatar
steps.detail: Show a real face for authenticity; if you'd rather not, clone an avatar for talking-head segments, or generate the script first and read it on camera. Avatars suit information-dense content; emotion and opinion want a real person.
steps.tips: Avatars are least jarring in high-information pieces — keep the emotional and opinion content human.

steps.title: Serialization
steps.detail: Build series recognition with a fixed intro, outro, BGM and caption style, produce multiple episodes per series in batch, and end each episode with a teaser for the next.
steps.tips: A fixed intro plus a signature catchphrase creates instant series recognition and a reason to come back.

steps.title: Operations
steps.detail: Aggregate follower demographics and engagement, let the model analyze which pillars and topics grow followers, and feed that back into direction and cadence. Also bank a catchphrase library and a winning-topics library.
steps.tips: Keep the catchphrase and topic libraries in a doc the model reuses each episode — it gets easier the longer you run.

pitfalls.title: Drifting persona
pitfalls.detail: One version this week, another next week confuses fans; once you set the rules, keep them.

pitfalls.title: Avatar overuse
pitfalls.detail: All-avatar content reads as fake and untrustworthy; show a real person now and then.

pitfalls.title: Content without assets
pitfalls.detail: A vlog should bank catchphrases, footage and topics so production gets easier.

pitfalls.title: Unstable cadence
pitfalls.detail: Series vlogs live on a fixed rhythm; gaps bleed followers.
